d: Job Title: Senior Commercial Underwriting Specialist
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home

We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Underwriting Specialist to support the assessment, analysis, and management of commercial insurance risks across business portfolios. The role focuses on reviewing underwriting submissions, analyzing risk information, evaluating policy documentation, monitoring portfolio performance, and providing technical recommendations to support informed underwriting decisions.

The successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of commercial insurance products, risk assessment methodologies, policy structures, and underwriting governance. Working remotely, the specialist will collaborate with brokers, clients, actuaries, risk engineers, claims teams, and internal stakeholders to support accurate risk analysis and efficient underwriting operations.

This position is designed as a fully remote underwriting analysis and technical support role. Physical risk surveys, property inspections, engineering assessments, site visits, and in-person verification must be conducted by qualified local personnel where required. Binding underwriting decisions, policy issuance, coverage approvals, and commitments must be made or authorized by appropriately licensed or delegated underwriting professionals.
Review commercial insurance submissions, proposal forms, supporting documentation, and risk information for completeness and accuracy.
Analyze commercial risks across relevant insurance lines, including property, liability, engineering, marine, business interruption, and other specialty classes.
Assess exposure information, loss histories, business activities, asset values, and risk characteristics to support underwriting evaluations.
Review policy terms, conditions, exclusions, limits, deductibles, warranties, and endorsements for technical consistency.
Support underwriting recommendations through structured risk analysis and documented assessment findings.
Coordinate with brokers, clients, risk engineers, actuaries, claims teams, and internal departments to obtain additional underwriting information.
Analyze historical claims data, loss ratios, portfolio trends, and exposure concentrations to identify potential risk concerns.
Review risk survey reports and engineering assessments prepared by qualified local professionals.
Support pricing analysis and premium calculations using approved underwriting methodologies and delegated procedures.
Monitor portfolio performance, renewal pipelines, outstanding submissions, and underwriting service-level targets.
Assist with the preparation of underwriting reports, risk summaries, referral documents, and management dashboards.
Identify unusual exposures, coverage gaps, accumulation risks, and potential deviations from underwriting guidelines.
Support underwriting audits, quality reviews, documentation checks, and corrective action initiatives.
Monitor developments in insurance markets, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and emerging commercial risk trends.
Recommend improvements to underwriting workflows, documentation standards, risk evaluation processes, and portfolio monitoring practices.
Maintain accurate digital underwriting records and ensure confidential handling of client, broker, and commercially sensitive information.
Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional insurance qualifications, such as ACII, CPCU, or equivalent credentials, are an advantage.
Significant experience in commercial insurance underwriting, risk assessment, underwriting operations, or insurance portfolio management.
Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, policy structures, coverage conditions, exclusions, limits, and endorsements.
Experience reviewing underwriting submissions, financial information, claims histories, risk surveys, and supporting documentation.
Familiarity with commercial property, liability, engineering, marine, and other specialty insurance classes.
Knowledge of underwriting guidelines, risk rating principles, exposure analysis, and portfolio performance indicators.
Experience using underwriting platforms, policy administration systems, data analysis tools, and reporting applications.
Understanding of insurance regulatory requirements, underwriting governance, and risk management principles.
Strong analytical, numerical, research, and decision-support skills.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Ability to manage competing priorities and work independently in a fully remote environment.
High attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and commitment to responsible underwriting practices.
100% remote working arrangement with the flexibility to work from home.
Full-time opportunity within a commercial insurance and underwriting environment.
Exposure to diverse commercial risk portfolios and specialist insurance products.
Opportunities to contribute to underwriting quality, portfolio optimization, and risk management initiatives.
Collaboration with experienced insurance professionals, brokers, actuaries, and technical specialists.
Opportunities for continued professional development and career advancement.
Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their commercial underwriting experience, insurance qualifications, relevant product knowledge, and risk assessment expertise.
Application Email Subject: Application – Senior Commercial Underwriting Specialist (UAE Remote)
Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

Important Scope Note: This is a fully remote specialist role focused on underwriting analysis, submission reviews, risk assessment support, portfolio monitoring, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. Physical risk surveys, property inspections, engineering assessments, site visits, and in-person verification must be performed by qualified local personnel where required. Binding underwriting decisions, policy issuance and commitments, coverage approvals, pricing exceptions outside delegated authority, reinsurance commitments, regulated financial determinations, regulatory submissions, and statutory sign-offs must be performed or approved by appropriately licensed or authorized underwriting, actuarial, legal, or compliance professionals.
